Common Questions

Who can participate?
The challenge is open to students who are currently enrolled in a university and working professionals.
How many members can a team have?
Teams should consist of 3 to 5 members. Each member must submit an individual application and indicate the same team name during registration.
Do I need prior AI experience?
Prior AI experience is not required. Teams will be expected to develop an AI-powered prototype.
Can I participate if I am currently overseas?
Participants must be able to attend the event onsite at Garena Singapore's office on 23 August 2026.
